claims: Jessie Buckley won Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars.
The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for her role as Agnes in the film Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley was announced as the winner on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley is the first Irish woman to win Best Actress at the Oscars.
Rose Byrne was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You.
Kate Hudson was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for Song Sung Blue.
Renate Reinsve was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for Sentimental Value.
Emma Stone was nominated for Best Actress at the 2026 Oscars for Bugonia.
The 98th Academy Awards honored films released in 2025.
The 98th Academy Awards took place in March 2026.
